# Veto

> Authorization for TypeScript apps and the AI agents working in them. A policy is a pure function of the user returning an array of rules — plain JSON. The same array answers `can()`, compiles to a SQL `WHERE`, checks writes field by field and guards an agent's tool calls for the person the agent acts for; it crosses the server/client boundary untouched and fails closed on malformed data. The engine has no runtime dependencies.

Install `@vetojs/core` for the engine and `@vetojs/core/guard`; add `@vetojs/react` for `<Can>` / `useCan` / `useAbility`, or `@vetojs/drizzle` to filter a query in SQL. ESM only, Node 20+.

If you are generating code that uses this library, read [For agents](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/for-agents.md) first — the whole API on one page, plus the mistakes that look plausible but are wrong.

## Start here

- [For agents](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/for-agents.md): the complete API, correct idioms, mistakes to avoid.
- [Project README](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/README.md): what the library does and how it compares to CASL.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/README.md): a page per concept, English and Russian.

## Agents

- [Guarding what an agent does](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/agents.md): tool calls checked against the person's policy, per-field refusals a model can act on, a `deny` on an environment key to give the agent less than its person, tools with no table (mail, files, payments) judged on a row built from the arguments.

## A policy

- [Declaring resources](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/define-abilities.md): `defineAbilities` — every type is inferred from it; `env` declares what a rule's `when` reads.
- [Rules](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/create-rules.md): `createRules` — `where` (which rows), `fields` and `values` (what may be written), `when` (which requests), `manage`, the stored JSON form.
- [Checking access](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/ability.md): `buildAbility` — `can`, `authorize`, `permittedFields`, `validate`, `onDecision`; `withEnv` binds the request's environment.

## Conditions

- [Conditions](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/conditions.md): the shorthand, operators by field type, `{ ref }` to compare two fields of a row, the stored tree, unknown.
- [Operators](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/operators.md): all thirteen, with the `null`, type-mismatch and `NaN` behaviour that keeps checks safe.
- [Relations](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/relations.md): conditions across related resources, and why a relation you forgot to load throws.

## Enforcing

- [How a decision is made](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/rule-evaluation.md): deny wins, default deny, unknown never grants.
- [Writes](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/mutations.md): `canMutate` for the row, `validatePayload` for fields and values.
- [Filtering in the database](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/where.md): `ability.where()` selects exactly the rows `can()` allows.
- [Rules from outside](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/parse.md): `parseRules` — the gate for rule JSON from a database or the network; it checks shape, not names.

## In an app

- [The guard](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/guard.md): `createGuard` → `withPermission` — the actor, the row and the payload checked before a server action, an HTTP handler or a tool call runs.
- [HTTP handlers](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/http.md): Express, Fastify, Hono, with no framework package.
- [React](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/react.md): `createVetoContext(ac)` → `AbilityProvider`, `<Can>`, `useCan`, `useSetRules`; `@vetojs/react/server` gates a server component.
- [Server rendering](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/ssr.md): rules across the boundary beyond RSC, and why a static page cannot carry a verdict.
- [Drizzle](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/drizzle.md): `defineTables` → `filter` — the policy as a SQL `WHERE`. Postgres.
- [Postgres RLS](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/rls.md): running veto alongside row-level security.
- [Migrating from CASL](https://github.com/ivan-yuldashev/vetojs/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-casl.md): API mapping and the behaviour that differs.
